Roberto, you shared our IEP data post on April 28, that's a specific enough signal that I wanted to write directly rather than wait.

At roughly 630 IEPs across Westbrook City Schools, your case managers and related-service providers are carrying a documentation load that competes directly with student time. Teachers on teams like yours report saving more than four hours per day once Journify sits alongside their existing IEP system, drafting present levels, generating progress notes, and building instructional materials tied to each student's goals. Ohio's IDEA compliance monitoring adds a second layer of pressure, and the teams that feel it most are the ones writing everything twice.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this week so you can see how it fits your current workflow?
